title: Kitty loves catnip, but not toys.
text:
My kitty loved the items with catnip, and they kept her entertained. However, she had no interest in the cute toys so I would like to cancel the future boxes due to her dislike of the majority of toys.

June 23, 2020 These 2 boxes of toys & treats have been with my kitty for several weeks. I give up.....she has no interest in the toys. So I had called last month and spoke with the very nice young man. He suggested that I get in touch with Amazon which is what i'm doing and also cancelled my membership. Thank you so much for the great way you handled this. It was a great idea and done up so nicely.
